title_cyr: Ајде чиво ли е она девојче
title_latin: Ajde čivo li e ona devojče
title_en: Come on, Whose Is That Girl
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'рудоно стадо' is my reading as 'reddish flock'; 'изим' read as 'permission' from context. 'Вода ја однесло' is taken literally.

lines.cyr: Ајде чиво ли е она девојче
lines.lat: Ajde čivo li e ona devojče
lines.en: Come on, whose is that girl
in our little garden, oh dear,
in our little garden?
Who has let loose her red-blond hair,
from shoulder to shoulder, oh dear,
from shoulder to shoulder?
Come on, like a shepherd's reddish flock
from hill to hill, oh dear,
from hill to hill.

lines.cyr: Ајде изим давај, стара бре мајко,
lines.lat: Ajde izim davaj, stara bre majko,
lines.en: Come on, give me leave, old mother,
whether I should take her, oh dear,
whether I should take her?

lines.cyr: Море изим имаш мили бре синко,
lines.lat: More izim imaš mili bre sinko,
lines.en: Hey, you have leave, dear son,
go and look for her, oh dear,
go and look for her.

lines.cyr: Ајде вода ја однесло, бре синко,
lines.lat: Ajde voda ja odneslo, bre sinko,
lines.en: Come on, the water carried her off, son,
it brought her to you, oh dear,
it brought her to you.

lines.cyr: Море пари давам, ич не ги жалам,
lines.lat: More pari davam, ič ne gi žalam,
lines.en: Hey, I give money, I don't grudge it at all,
only so that I may take her, oh dear,
only so that I may take her.

lines.cyr: Ајде пари давам, сè жолти дукати,
lines.lat: Ajde pari davam, sè žolti dukati,
lines.en: Come on, I give money, all yellow ducats,
only so that I may take her, oh dear,
only so that I may take her.
